title: Separation & Conditioning
summary: Engineered separation and conditioning equipment for gas, liquid and multiphase industrial applications, including separators, filtration systems and customized equipment packages.
body:
Tongyang Process supports the design coordination and manufacturing of separation equipment and integrated equipment packages for chemical, petrochemical, oil and gas applications.

Our equipment scope may include gas-liquid separators, oil-water separators, filter vessels, desanding equipment and associated mechanical components.

Equipment selection is based on process flow rates, operating pressures, temperatures, fluid properties, separation requirements and applicable engineering standards.

We work with clients to evaluate equipment configurations and establish suitable mechanical solutions for project-specific operating conditions.
seoDescription: Industrial separation and conditioning systems, including gas-liquid separators, oil-water separators, filtration and customized process equipment packages.
